subject: Animation
title: Fantasia: Music Meets Animation
description: One-minute skill: Fantasia: Music Meets Animation.

hook.text: Walt Disney wanted a film where animation illustrated classical music with no dialogue at all.

buildup.text: Fantasia paired eight orchestral pieces with wildly different animated sequences and visual styles.

discovery.text: The film introduced Fantasound, an early surround-sound system designed specifically for theaters.

twist.text: Fantasia was a box-office disaster. Audiences in 1940 were confused by a plotless art experiment.

climax.text: Over decades, Fantasia was reappraised as a masterpiece of visual artistry and creative ambition.

punchline.text: A plotless art film became animation's Mona Lisa.

quiz.question: What was unique about Fantasia?
options: It was the first Disney film with a female lead
It paired animated sequences with classical music and introduced early surround sound
It was the first animated film in color
